Alia Bhatt discusses stress and laughter during film shoot

Actress Alia Bhatt shared an anecdote about her smart device interpreting her stress levels during a film shoot. She explained that the device indicated she was under significant stress, which she attributed to prolonged laughter during the filming of 'Latent 2'. The incident occurred during a segment on Samay Raina's show.
